mainEntity.name: What is an SEO reseller programme?

acceptedAnswer.text: It lets an agency sell SEO and other marketing services under its own brand while a partner delivers them. With MMC you buy each package at a wholesale rate, bill your own client and keep the difference.

mainEntity.name: How is reselling different from referral or white-label delivery?

acceptedAnswer.text: When you resell, you bill the client and keep the relationship. In a referral the provider bills the client directly and the relationship moves to them. White-label delivery also keeps the client with you, but the scope is shaped per client rather than packaged.
MMC bills your agency the wholesale rate. You bill your client the price you set. Your margin is the difference, less the time your own team spends on the account.

mainEntity.name: Is there a joining fee or a minimum commitment?

acceptedAnswer.text: The minimum commitment is three months. Any other terms are agreed on the call and written down before work starts.
Yes, you can present them under your own names and brand.

mainEntity.name: Can I resell to clients abroad?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can. We deliver for agencies in the US, UK, Canada, Australia, the UAE, Singapore, India and the rest of Europe. See how hours and invoicing work on the page about our white-label agency in India.

mainEntity.name: Which currencies do you invoice in?

acceptedAnswer.text: Indian rupees or US dollars. We agree which one when we write the scope.
We provide a one-page summary of each package that you can adapt, answers to common client questions and a named contact for scope questions.

mainEntity.name: Will my client know MMC is involved?

acceptedAnswer.text: Only if you choose to tell them. We sign an NDA, work under your brand, send deliverables in your format and do not contact your clients unless you ask us to.

mainEntity.name: How do we get started with the white-label reseller programme?

acceptedAnswer.text: Tell us the market you sell to and which services interest you. After the NDA we agree packages and onboarding.

points.title: Your pricing

paras: You choose services from the white-label range, we agree a written scope for each package, and you sell them to your clients under your own service names. MMC invoices your agency at a wholesale rate; you invoice your client at the price you set. We deliver and report to you, never to your client.
The difference from general outsourcing is repeatability: defined packages rather than bespoke teams. For a flexible team, see agency outsourcing.

blocks.h: Reselling, referral and white-label delivery compared
paras: Agencies use three arrangements to sell work they do not deliver themselves. The difference is who bills the client, who owns the relationship and how you earn.

Reselling, which is this programme. You buy a defined package at a wholesale rate and bill your own client at your price. The client stays yours and sees your brand. You earn the difference between the two.

Referral. You introduce the client to a provider, who contracts and bills them directly. The client relationship moves to the provider, and any referral fee is whatever the two of you agree. The client knows who does the work.

White-label delivery. As with reselling, you bill the client and keep the relationship, but the scope is shaped per client or run by a dedicated team, and priced to that scope. It suits bespoke or high-volume work; reselling suits repeatable packages.

paras: Packages can be built from any service we deliver white label: SEO, including local SEO for US and UK businesses, link building, Google Ads and PPC, paid social, web development, Shopify, WordPress, content writing, social media management and reporting.
Each package lists what the client gets each month, what is out of scope and how changes are priced, so your sales team can quote it without checking with us first.

blocks.h: Who bills whom and how margin works
paras: MMC invoices your agency at the wholesale rate for each package, in Indian rupees or US dollars. You invoice your client on your own paper, at your own price. MMC never invoices or contacts your client.

Your margin is your client price minus the wholesale rate and the time your own team spends managing the account. The pricing models page shows how to work it out. Ad spend is paid by the client to the ad platform and is not part of a package.
The minimum commitment is three months.

One-page summaries of each package that you can adapt and put your name on, answers to the questions clients usually ask, and a named contact for scope questions before you quote. On the call we can walk you through an anonymised sample audit.

blocks.h: Joining: steps and what we need from you
paras: Register your agency, then we hold a call to agree which packages you will resell first. We sign an NDA, write the scopes and run your first client as a pilot.
From you we need the markets you sell to, the services your clients ask for, the service names and branding you want on reports, and one contact on your side.

stages.why: If you cannot describe the package in a line, your sales team cannot sell it twice the same way.
stages.does: We provide defined packages with a written scope and sales material, which you can rename and position.

stages.breaks: Writing a custom scope for every client.
stages.why: Every bespoke scope is a new risk and a new delay before the work can start.
stages.does: Packages carry a written scope you can reuse. Changes are quoted separately, so the base stays clean.

stages.k: Onboard the same way each time
stages.why: Missing logins and unclear goals slow every project, and you end up chasing information.
stages.does: One intake and one client code per client, with a checklist for what we need from you.

stages.why: A client asks for an update and you have to ask us before you can answer.
stages.does: A delivery tracker against the written scope, with a named contact on our side.

stages.why: A package that sold well can still lose money if the cost of delivery was not clear when you priced it.
stages.does: You set the client price, you know our delivery cost under the agreement, and your margin is visible per package.
